title: Runtime scale factor bounds
statement: Let $n,a,d,s$ be positive integers with $2a\le d$ and $s\ge1$, and set $\varepsilon=a/d$ and $R=(n+1)(s+1)/\varepsilon$. Then $R\ge1$, $n+1\le R$, $s+1\le R$, and $1/\varepsilon\le R$.
